## Checklist

- [ ] `cargo fmt --check`, `cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings` and `cargo test` pass
- [ ] `--selftest` passes, if this touches sources, outputs or timing
- [ ] A bug fix comes with a test that would have caught it
- [ ] Older project files still open
- [ ] Clean room: nothing was taken from vMix or other closed software, and no GPL code was copied
- [ ] AI tools used, if any, are mentioned above
